content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGRUA Assistant (Library) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant (Library) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates with a minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar capacity. Preference will be given to those holding a diploma in library science.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant (Library) post is 35 years, as of 01-06-2026.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Assistant (Library) position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a written test, and finally an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant (Library) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 30,000, along with a Transport Allowance of ₹1800 and an Aviation Allowance of ₹300.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the IGRUA Assistant (Library) job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi located?
faq.answer: The Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi is located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 229302.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Assistant (Library) position is a contractual job opportunity offered by the Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi.
